description:
Bona ukusebenza ngokucacile.

Qala ngenkundla ofuna ukuyihlola. I-LumaTrace izokuqondisa esinyathelweni esilandelayo futhi igcine amamethrikhi angatholakali njenge-N/A.

Windows: Khetha inqubo yohlelo lokusebenza noma igeyimu kule khompyutha, bese uqala ukuhlola. Uma inqubo iphuma, ukuhlola kuyama noma kurekhodwe ukuphazamiseka okucacile.

Android: Vula izinketho zonjiniyela nokulungisa amaphutha nge-USB efonini, ugunyaze le khompyutha, uvule uhlelo lokusebenza ofuna ukulihlola, bese uchofoza Qala Ukuhlola. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzakalela iphakheji elingaphambili.

Khetha umphumela ukuze ubuke i-FPS, i-1% Low, isikhathi sozimele, i-CPU, imemori nemibiko ekhishiwe.

I-Android igcina i-ADB logcat ehlanziwe yesikhathi sokuhlola. I-Windows igcina amarekhodi eseshini ye-LumaTrace anezikhathi.

Amanani angekho ahlala eyi-N/A futhi awagcwaliswa ngo-0.

Akukho ukulayisha efwini
